title: 金糸の檻と、薄紅の幻想曲
author: 蘭 マリア

en.title: The Golden Cage and the Pale Crimson Fantasia
en.premise: Eliana, the daughter of a fallen noble house, returns to the Imperial Capital for a grand masquerade ball, driven by a single goal: to clear her father's tarnished name. There, she crosses paths with a mysterious envoy from the Far East—a lonely young man captivated by the beauty of falling cherry blossoms. But beneath the opulence of jewels and lace, a sinister conspiracy begins to stir, threatening to shake the very foundations of the empire.

zh.title: 金丝之笼与淡红幻想曲
zh.premise: 没落名门之女艾莉安娜，为了洗刷父亲的污名，重返举办假面舞会的帝都。在那里，她邂逅了一位来自极东之国的神秘特使——一名倾心于落樱之美的孤独青年。而在宝石与蕾丝交织的奢华之夜背后，一场足以撼动国家根基的恐怖阴谋，正悄然拉开序幕。
